name: Cable Incline Curl
steps: Set an incline bench facing a low pulley and grasp its bar with an underhand grip.
Rest your chest against the pad and extend your arms toward the pulley.
Bend your elbows to draw the bar toward your forehead.
Lower the bar under control until your arms lengthen again.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad and your upper arms still.
Keep your wrists straight as the cable draws your forearms forward.
